text:
Situation: Corvale East holds 84 vials of eribulin mesylate 0.5 mg/mL, 2 mL, with daily use of 4.8 vials, providing 17.6 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show eribulin mesylate is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately 17.6 days. The top-ranked purchasing option is Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., which is also not on FDA's shortage list today. Hikma's supply is traced to Kindos Pharmaceuticals Co., Ltd., whose last inspection was classified VAI on 2024-07-19. Additional alternate manufacturers include Apotex Corp., BSP Pharmaceuticals SpA, Baxter Healthcare Company, and Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd., none of which is on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place order with Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. — requires approval by pharmacy director.
2. Buyer to qualify Apotex Corp. as secondary source — requires approval by pharmacy director and quality assurance.
3. Buyer to qualify BSP Pharmaceuticals SpA as tertiary source — requires approval by pharmacy director and quality assurance.
4. Buyer to monitor inventory daily and report days on hand to pharmacy director — requires approval by pharmacy director.

Not recommended: No allocation, rationing, or therapeutic substitution at this time.
